title: Percentage-of-amount fee raised to minCap: 0.1% of 1,200,000.00 = 1,200.00, minCap 8,000.00 -> fee 8,000.00 MNT.
_note: The minCap branch of charges.MinimumAndMaximumCap (nexus/internal/apps/charges/money.go:87-89, the raise-to-minCap arm), which no pre-existing vector reached because all 12 committed charges vectors omit min_cap_minor/max_cap_minor. A PERCENT_OF_AMOUNT (calculation_type 2, time_type 1 DISBURSEMENT) charge on the loan principal 1,200,000.00 at 0.1%. The exact product 1,200,000.00 x 0.1% = 1,200.00 has no fraction (120000 minor units) and is BELOW minCap 8,000.00, so the oracle raises it to the cap: totalFeeChargesCharged = 8000.00, feeChargesDue = 8000.00 on the disbursement row of the committed raw capture. The vector transcribes the fee AFTER the clamp.

provenance.note: TRANSCRIBED, never computed, from the committed T51 capture T51-TR-12-c2-mincap. No oracle contact was made by this promotion; every figure is read off the committed raw JSON. fee_minor 800000 is the exact major->minor scaling of the observed totalFeeChargesCharged 8000.00 (feeChargesDue 8000.000000); base_amount_minor 120000000 is the exact scaling of totalPrincipalDisbursed 1,200,000.00; percentage 100000 is 0.1% in micro-per-cent (m_charge stores whole per cent as DECIMAL(19,6): 0.100000); min_cap_minor 800000 is the exact scaling of the charge definition's minCap 8000. The un-clamped product 120000 is NOT an observed fee and is recorded only as the arithmetical witness that 8000.00 is the RAISED value, not the product.
